newsitem.title: USA: General Binding buying Quartet Mfg.
newsitem.headline: General Binding buying Quartet Mfg.

text.p: General Binding Corp said on Tuesday it entered into an agreement to buy Quartet Manufacturing Co of Skokie, Ill. for cash.
It said Quartet, with projected 1996 revenues of $150 million, manufactures and distributes visual communications products including marketboards, bulletin boards and easels.
The transaction, which is to be effective as of January 1, 1997, will close in early January, subject to necessary regulatory approvals.

The acquisition will strengthen General Binding's position in the office products market and accelerate its goal of growing to $1 billion in revenues by the year 2000, said president Govi Reddy in a statement.
General Binding provides binding and laminating systems.
